changes: Inspection order acceptance now fires a second, distinct FUB milestone task (inspection_payment_pending, assigned to Nate) specifically for chasing the wire, separate from the scheduling milestone.
Inspection order decline now sends an internal admin notification email (previously silent — nobody was told when a client declined).

Signed inspection add-ons now trigger a client-facing wiring-instructions email + PDF for the add-on's own amount (previously only an internal admin HOLD note existed; the client was never told how to pay for the add-on).
Admin Inspection Orders table now shows a paid_amount-derived Payment badge (Unpaid / Partial / Paid) alongside status.

Removed the stale invoice_sent milestone fired at order completion — under the prepaid model, payment is always collected before the vendor order is placed, so a 'final invoice / payment due' task at completion was misleading.

New hourly scheduler (checkAndSendInspectionPaymentReminders) sends a one-time reminder to clients (and admins, if no client email on file) for orders accepted 48+ hours ago that are still unpaid or only partially paid.
Wiring deadline language ('within 48 hours') added to inspection terms, wiring PDF, and wiring email HTML for concreteness.
__bundleNotes: paid_amount is server-computed at request time (not a bundle string) - verified via mathChecks against the live /api/admin/inspection-orders payload instead of Layer 2. 'Final invoice ready' (old invoice_sent milestone text) and 'Please wire within 48 hours' (wiring email/PDF copy) are server-only strings never shipped to the client bundle, so they cannot be checked at Layer 2 - confirmed removed/present via direct source grep during development instead.

mathChecks.name: Admin inspection orders response includes a numeric paid_amount on every row
